annotations.title: Change publication status, vacancy lifecycle or embedding

description:
[Interviews] Change an interview's or position's publication `status` (draft, active, archived...), or a position's vacancy `lifecycle` (open, applications_closed, on_hold, filled, cancelled, closed) with an optional reason_id and note, or its embed key (is_embedded). Moving a position to filled, cancelled or closed, or archiving it, e-mails every candidate whose application is still open, when the company has the position-closed notice on. on_hold and cancelled need a reason_id: one of the company's position status reasons from list_reasons type=position_status, whose applies_to has the lifecycle. dry_run=true answers the status change and whether the position-closed e-mail would go out, to how many candidates, without changing anything. A deleted interview can no longer be read or updated; an archived one can. is_embedded=false removes the embed keys, so existing embeds stop working.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

dry_run.description: true: change nothing; answer the status before and after and whether the position-closed e-mail would go out, to how many candidates. It does not check whether the move is allowed: the real call can still refuse it.

is_embedded.description: Controls iframe embedding of the interview on an external page. A signed coaching embed (name, email, signature) signs the visitor in as a learner of that portal, and the session is charged to the merchant's interview credits on completion, not to the learner's coaching credits; it cannot start while the merchant has none.

lifecycle.description: Multi-stage positions only: the vacancy lifecycle to move to. draft goes to open or cancelled; open, applications_closed and on_hold go to each other or to filled, cancelled or closed; those three go back to open. on_hold and cancelled need reason_id. filled, cancelled and closed archive the position and can e-mail every candidate with an open application (the position-closed notice, when switched on). Needs the position_lifecycle feature (403 otherwise). Send either status or lifecycle, not both. A stand-alone interview has no lifecycle: close it with status archived. open, applications_closed and on_hold e-mail no one.

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

note.description: With lifecycle: a note kept in the position's status history (at most 1000 characters).

position_id.description: Interview definition id (an interview `id` from list_interviews) or position id (a position `id` from list_interviews) whose state should change.

reason_id.description: With lifecycle: a position status reason of the company that applies to the target lifecycle (an id from list_reasons with type position_status).

status.description: New publication status. Refused (422) for the AI interview step of a position, which follows its position, and for activating a position whose required custom fields are empty. Archiving an active position can e-mail its candidates with open applications (the position-closed notice, when switched on). A deleted interview can no longer be read or updated; an archived one can. preparing (a draft still being prepared) and completed (finished, read as closed) are normally set by the platform; filling or closing a position is `lifecycle`.

name: set_interview_state
